name: bae-gemini-eye
description: A tiny remote MCP server that lets Claude watch videos through Google Gemini (picture and sound).

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Your Google Gemini API key, from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey

ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Any long random text (20+ characters). Your connector URL ends with /mcp/<this text>.

GEMINI_MODEL.description: Gemini model that watches the videos. Default gemini-3.8-flash.
